folder_html:
LIVE UV INDEX

Erythemal (sunburning) UV Index at the lake surface from the newest 12 UTC NCEP run, forecast hour nearest the current time. A forecast field, not a satellite observation: the displayed hour advances as time passes.

UV Index (UV Index), fixed absolute scale: LOWEST 0 (green, low) → 3-5 (yellow, moderate) → 6-7 (orange, high) → 8-10 (red, very high) → HIGHEST+ 11+ (violet, extreme). Same index always shows the same color. Current maximum over the lakes: 4.6.

Units: UV Index
Source: NOAA/NCEP CPC Global UV Index, operational GRIB2 (12 UTC GFS run, hourly steps to 120 h)
Source run: 2026-09-23 08:00 AM EDT
Forecast hour: +8h
Valid time: 2026-09-23 04:00 PM EDT
Source version: uvi-20260923-t12z-f08
Processed: 2026-09-23 04:25 PM EDT
Why high values turn red/purple: Extreme UV (11+) compresses into violet/deep-purple; ordinary low/moderate values own most of the color resolution.
Provenance: CPC UV documentation
